# Tallyard

> Free calculators and guides for home-improvement planning. Each page describes its own inputs, assumptions, and limits.

Site: https://www.tallyard.com

There are 50 calculators and worksheets, 6 reference and buying guides, and 10 project-cost guides. Tools vary in scope. Verify product coverage, project conditions, and local requirements before relying on an estimate.

## Calculators and worksheets

- [Paint Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/paint-calculator): Estimate wall paint from room dimensions, coats, and coverage. Optionally include the ceiling and check the selected product label before buying.
- [Concrete Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/concrete-calculator): Estimate geometric concrete volume for rectangular or round shapes from entered dimensions and a user-selected planning allowance. Not a structural design or supplier order guarantee.
- [Tile Package Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/tile-calculator): Estimate tile packages from rectangular area, the coverage printed on the package, and a user-selected planning allowance.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/mulch-calculator): Estimate mulch volume from a rectangular area and user-selected depth, with an optional count for nominal 2 ft³ bags.
- [Drywall Panel Area Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/drywall-calculator): Estimate panel count from net measured surface area and a selected nominal panel size. Does not create a layout or finishing-material takeoff.
- [Roof Surface Area Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/roofing-calculator): Estimate sloped surface area for a simple rectangular roof plane from its horizontal footprint and pitch. Does not calculate a roof material order.
- [Room Air Conditioner Capacity Guide](https://www.tallyard.com/btu-calculator): Estimate room air-conditioner capacity from room area using the ENERGY STAR sizing guide and its stated adjustments. Not a whole-home HVAC load calculation.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/gravel-calculator): Estimate aggregate volume from area and selected depth, with an approximate weight based on a stated material-density assumption. Not a site or pavement design.
- [Solar Energy-Use Scenario Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/solar-calculator): Explore a panel-count scenario from entered electricity use and explicitly selected assumptions. Not a site assessment, production forecast, or system design.
- [Wire Size Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/wire-size-calculator): Preliminary AWG estimate from ampacity and voltage drop for a limited range of inputs. Installation conditions and local code require an electrician's review.
- [Insulation Package Coverage Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/insulation-calculator): Estimate package count from measured area, exact product-label coverage, and a user-selected allowance. Does not recommend R-value or insulation type.
- [Fence Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/fence-calculator): Preliminary posts, rails, and pickets for one straight fence run. Gates, corners, and post-hole concrete require a site-specific layout.
- [Grout Package Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/grout-calculator): Estimate grout packages from measured tiled area and coverage for the exact product and package. Does not calculate joint yield or select grout type.
- [Paver Area and Count Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/paver-calculator): Estimate paver count for a rectangular area using selected nominal dimensions and a user-selected planning allowance.
- [Decking Board Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/deck-calculator): Estimate deck surface area and a rough decking-board quantity for a simple rectangle. This does not size or design the supporting structure.
- [Flooring Package Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/flooring-calculator): Estimate flooring package count from rectangular area, package coverage printed on the label, and an allowance you select.
- [Soil Volume Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/topsoil-calculator): Estimate soil volume from a rectangular area and user-selected depth, with an optional package-count estimate for a selected bag size.
- [Sod Area and Piece Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/sod-calculator): Estimate lawn area and piece count from a rectangular measurement, selected package format, and user-set planning allowance.
- [Asphalt Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/asphalt-calculator): Estimate asphalt volume and approximate weight from area, selected compacted thickness, and an explicit density assumption. Not a pavement design.
- [Lumber Board-Foot and Lineal-Length Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/lumber-calculator): Calculate nominal board-foot and lineal-foot totals from a selected size, length, quantity, and optional user-selected allowance. No price or weight estimate.
- [Stair Geometry Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/stair-calculator): Estimate equalized riser count and geometric rise/run from user-selected dimensions. Not a code check or construction cut sheet.
- [Reinforcing Bar Grid Geometry Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/rebar-calculator): Estimate the number and gross length of grid runs from a rectangular footprint and user-selected maximum spacing. Not reinforcement design or a bar order list.
- [Brick Quantity Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/brick-calculator): Estimate brick count from net wall area, product-specific unit coverage, and a user-selected allowance. Does not estimate mortar or design a wall.
- [Wallpaper Roll-Coverage Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/wallpaper-calculator): Estimate roll count from net measured wall area, exact product-label coverage, and a user-selected allowance. Does not account for pattern or installation layout.
- [Shower Tile Package Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/shower-tile-calculator): Estimate tile packages from a user-measured total tiled area, exact package coverage, and a selected planning allowance.
- [Backsplash Tile Package Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/backsplash-calculator): Estimate backsplash tile packages from measured tiled area, exact package coverage, and a user-selected allowance.
- [Vanity Wall-Width Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/vanity-calculator): Calculate the wall width remaining after the clearances you enter. Does not recommend a vanity or check bathroom-code clearances.
- [Countertop Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/countertop-calculator): Estimate countertop surface area and a separate island preset from simple measurements. This is not a fabrication or slab-order plan.
- [Siding Area Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/siding-calculator): Estimate cladding area from user-measured net wall surfaces and a chosen planning allowance. Does not estimate siding packages, trim, cost, or installation requirements.
- [Gutter-Run Length Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/gutter-calculator): Sum user-measured gutter runs and apply a chosen planning allowance. Does not size gutters, downspouts, or drainage systems.
- [Heating and Cooling Load Conversion Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/heat-pump-calculator): Convert user-provided heating and cooling loads to ton-equivalent arithmetic. This worksheet does not calculate building loads or select equipment.
- [Water-Heating Rate Conversion Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/water-heater-calculator): Convert user-entered water flow and temperature rise to a theoretical heat-transfer rate. Does not size or select a water heater.
- [Extension Cord Voltage-Drop Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/extension-cord-calculator): Estimate resistive voltage drop for a user-selected copper conductor gauge, current, length, and voltage. Does not recommend or certify a cord's safe load.
- [Attic Ventilation Ratio Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/attic-ventilation-calculator): Illustrative arithmetic for a user-selected attic-area ratio. Does not design a ventilation system or recommend vent products or quantities.
- [Pool Chlorine Mass Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/pool-chlorine-calculator): Estimate available-chlorine mass from a measured ppm gap, then estimate product mass only when the label gives available chlorine by weight. Not a dosing recommendation.
- [Shed Surface Area Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/shed-calculator): Estimate floor, wall, and simple gable-roof sheathing quantities from dimensions. This is an area takeoff, not a framing plan or structural design.
- [Rainfall Runoff Volume Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/rainwater-calculator): Estimate a rainfall-event runoff volume from a horizontal catchment area, rainfall depth, and user-selected capture factor.
- [Snow Load Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/snow-load-calculator): Approximate weight of a uniform snow and ice layer. This does not determine a roof's structural capacity or whether it is safe.
- [Straight-Wall Spacing Count Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/stud-spacing-calculator): Estimate evenly spaced points along a straight wall length from user-selected spacing. Does not design framing or count openings and connections.
- [Drainage Fixture-Unit Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/drain-pipe-calculator): Add illustrative drainage fixture-unit loads using selected IPC 2021 residential fixture assumptions. Does not size drain, branch, stack, sewer, or vent piping.
- [Kitchen Cabinet Run Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/kitchen-cabinet-calculator): Estimate cabinet run length and rough module count from wall measurements. Confirm openings, corners, fillers, and cabinet sizes in a final plan.
- [Garage Door Opening Measurement Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/garage-door-calculator): Record entered opening and clearance dimensions and calculate rectangular opening area. Does not select a door, track, spring, opener, or price.
- [Window Rectangle Area Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/window-sizing-calculator): Calculate the area of a user-entered rectangular window dimension pair. Does not determine egress, glazing, ventilation, rough openings, or code compliance.
- [Fireplace Opening Area Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/chimney-calculator): Calculate the geometric area of a rectangular fireplace opening. This tool does not size a flue, chimney, liner, or vent system.
- [Mortar Bag Estimator](https://www.tallyard.com/mortar-calculator): Estimate mortar bags from masonry unit count, exact package coverage, and a user-selected allowance. Does not select mortar type or give installation advice.
- [Furnace Replacement Quote Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/furnace-replacement-cost-calculator): Add line items entered from a written furnace-replacement quote. Does not size equipment or estimate current prices.
- [Net Clear Opening Area Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/egress-window-calculator): Calculate area from user-entered net clear opening dimensions. Does not determine egress compliance or suitability as an emergency exit.
- [Stair Geometry Calculator](https://www.tallyard.com/deck-stair-calculator): Explore equal-rise stair geometry from total rise, a user-selected target riser height, and tread run. Does not provide code checks or construction plans.
- [Hardwood Flooring Quote Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/hardwood-flooring-cost-calculator): Calculate a subtotal from measured area and per-square-foot rates copied from a written quote. Tallyard does not supply current material or labor prices.
- [Hardwood Refinishing Quote Worksheet](https://www.tallyard.com/hardwood-floor-refinishing-cost-calculator): Calculate a subtotal from measured floor area and a per-area rate and extras copied from a written refinishing quote. No current market prices are assumed.

## Guides

- [Vinyl vs fiber-cement siding: compare products and bids](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/vinyl-vs-fiber-cement-siding): Compare exact siding products, installation scope, maintenance instructions, and local written quotes for your home.
- [Composite vs pressure-treated vs cedar decking](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/composite-vs-pressure-treated-vs-cedar-deck): Compare exact decking products, maintenance instructions, warranty scope, and complete project quotes without a generic lifecycle-cost verdict.
- [Heat pump vs furnace + AC: comparing project-specific costs](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/heat-pump-vs-furnace): Compare system designs, complete installation scope, local energy prices, and current incentives for your home.
- [Construction Material Allowance: Plan Waste by Project](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/waste-factor-reference): How to set and verify a project-specific material allowance using product coverage, layout, and supplier terms.
- [Residential Code Reference: Verify Local Requirements](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/residential-code-limits-reference): A practical checklist for identifying the code edition, local amendments, and project-specific rules that apply to residential work.
- [Joist Span Reference: Inputs to Verify Before Building](https://www.tallyard.com/guides/joist-span-reference): Learn which project details determine joist spans and where to verify structural requirements for your location.

Project-cost guides: https://www.tallyard.com/guides
Methodology and limitations: https://www.tallyard.com/methodology
Detailed calculator descriptions: https://www.tallyard.com/llms-full.txt
